items.text: Narrator now names the feedback composer's buttons and pictures.
Only the window in use animates a busy pane's light and the sidebar's busy sheen; background windows hold them still.
A minimized or covered window holds its title until it shows, while +list reads the newest title at once.
A git-status viewer in a minimized or covered window runs no git and catches up the moment it shows; a hidden page draws no frames.
The Windows skill no longer tells an agent that +set-state drives macOS accessibility APIs.
A test that stops its own app no longer needs to tell the crash reporter by hand.
A frame cap for output bursts was measured and backed out: it halved a scrolling pane's frame rate.
The 500-to-4,000-frames-a-second output burst no longer reproduces, so its task is closed without a change.
The hero carousel's tile test is now watched, and the terminal tile's missing border no longer reproduces.
A window opened the moment the session agent dies now comes up persistent, and the agent is back in under a second.
